_comment: Editorial content for ALTN. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Altern Energy Limited, incorporated in 1995 and a subsidiary of Descon Engineering Limited, owns and operates a 32 MW gas-fired thermal power plant that began commercial operations in June 2001. It supplies electricity to the Water and Power Development Authority, under a 30-year power purchase agreement with the Central Power Purchasing Agency (Guarantee) Limited, and also holds direct and indirect investments in other power-sector companies.
sourceNote: Company website (alternenergypk.com: home, investors relations, contact) and the PSX company profile (dps.psx.com.pk/company/ALTN: business description, key people, address), read 2026-10-17.
